title: Maximum XOR of Subsequences
summary: Given an integer array nums, choose two subsequences while maintaining the original order.
statement: Given an integer array nums, choose two subsequences while maintaining the original order. Calculate the bitwise XOR of elements in each subsequence and find the maximum possible value of the bitwise XOR of these two results. The XOR of an empty subsequence is considered 0.
constraints: Two to 100,000 nonnegative integers up to one billion.
The two chosen subsequences may overlap or be empty.
hints: An element included in both subsequences cancels, so only elements included in exactly one matter.
The problem is therefore maximum subset XOR, solved by a binary linear basis.
Insert each value by eliminating its highest bit, then greedily improve the answer from high bits down.
Every XOR of the two subsequences is a subset XOR and every subset XOR is attainable by placing that subset in only one subsequence.
editorial: Every XOR of the two subsequences is a subset XOR and every subset XOR is attainable by placing that subset in only one subsequence.

tests.explanation: Choosing five and two separately produces seven.
